questions.question: Into which forest do Merry and Pippin escape?
questions.note: Rohan's riders attack the Uruk-hai at its edge.

questions.question: What race of tree herders lives in Fangorn?
What is the name of the oldest Ent, who carries Merry and Pippin?
questions.note: He takes them for something nasty at first.

questions.question: What does Treebeard first think Merry and Pippin are?
What is the council of Ents called?
questions.note: It takes ages, and they decide not to go to war.

questions.question: What changes Treebeard's mind about going to war?
questions.answer: Seeing the forest Saruman cut down
choices: Seeing the forest Saruman cut down
An attack on Fangorn by Orcs
questions.note: Pippin has him take them past Isengard. Treebeard roars for the Ents.

questions.question: How do the Ents destroy Isengard?
questions.answer: They break the dam and flood it
choices: They break the dam and flood it
questions.note: The river pours into Saruman's pits and drowns the forges.

questions.question: What is the name of Saruman's tower at Isengard?
questions.note: Even the Ents cannot break it.

questions.question: What brand of pipe-weed do Merry and Pippin find in Isengard's stores?
questions.note: They are found lounging in the ruins, smoking and eating.

questions.question: To which three companions does Gandalf the White reveal himself in Fangorn?
questions.note: They attack him first, thinking he is Saruman.
